format.clock: single declared monotonic domain; drift in integer ppm

invariants: Render and capture layouts must be declared explicitly and have the same channel count; undeclared or mismatched layouts are rejected before audio is read.
A reference trace is one contiguous declared segment sequence; gaps or overlaps are rejected instead of interpolated.
Missing render or capture reference is an explicit state, never implicit silence.

Sample-coordinate conversion is exact rational arithmetic from the declared source rate to 16 kHz, plus declared integer ppm drift, truncated toward zero for nonnegative coordinates; negative mappings are rejected, never clamped. No wall-clock timestamp selects an echo path.
Known impulses must remain at their declared exact target coordinates after rate and drift conversion.
Teardown is idempotent, clears admitted traces, and rejects later submit or frame calls.
Public v0 ABI, descriptors, provider registry and default behavior are unchanged; this is a separate versioned proposal.
